answer: An echo must cross the ocean and return. A newcomer locks a $7 bond and gets a spiral call — a code through three listening posts — and has six hours to return it with proof of one real task at each post. Three listeners time the round trip: too fast means a relay, too slow a missed window, and a wrong code or skipped post burns the bond. Faking a hundred costs $700 in burned bonds, plus a hundred echoes, six hours and three real tasks each.
